nodes.name: Growth and sulfidation on NF
nodes.procedure: Wu et al. fabricated a Co₉S₈/Ni₃S₂ heterojunction by initially growing a layer of cobalt precursor nanoarray (Co(OH)₂F) on the surface of nickel foam (NF) and subsequently sulfiding the precursor. High-resolution transmission electron microscope (HRTEM) images reveal distinct interface boundaries, lattice distortion, and defects.
nodes.source_text: Wu et al. fabricated a Co₉S₈/Ni₃S₂ heterojunction by initially growing a layer of cobalt precursor nanoarray (Co(OH)₂F) on the surface of nickel foam (NF) and subsequently sulfiding the precursor.

nodes.name: MOF precursor calcination
nodes.procedure: Employed a metal-organic framework (Co-MOF@La(HCO₂)₃) as the precursor to synthesize (Co(OH)₂)₄@La(OH)₃ heterojunction.
nodes.source_text: Gao et al. employed a metal-organic framework (Co-MOF@La(HCO₂)₃) as the precursor to synthesize a (Co(OH)₂)₄@La(OH)₃ heterojunction

nodes.name: Electrospinning-oxidation-plasma engraving
nodes.procedure: Li et al. employed an electrospinning-oxidation-plasma engraving method to fabricate a heterojunction between NiO and In₂O₃ for OER. The In³⁺ ions act as an ionic electron compensator, creating more defects (oxygen vacancies, Vo) within the heterojunction (Vo-NiO/In₂O₃).
nodes.source_text: Li et al. employed an electrospinning-oxidation-plasma engraving method to fabricate a heterojunction between NiO and In₂O₃ for OER

nodes.name: Competitive reaction hydrothermal
nodes.procedure: Developed a competitive reaction strategy between Ni, Fe ions and OH⁻ using a one-step hydrothermal method, to construct a NiFe-LDH/FeOOH heterojunction. During the hydrothermal process, the addition of H₂O₂ facilitated Fenton-like reactions, generating a large amount of OH⁻, accelerating the precipitation of Ni²⁺ and Fe³⁺.
nodes.source_text: Wang et al. developed a competitive reaction strategy between Ni, Fe ions and OH⁻ using a one-step hydrothermal method, to construct a NiFe-LDH/FeOOH heterojunction...

nodes.name: Ion exchange hydrothermal
nodes.procedure: Synthesized a tellurium-based heterojunction (VTe₂@ZnFeTe) on Ni foam (NF) through ion exchange reactions employing the hydrothermal method. ZnFe-LDH precursor, Te²⁻, and Vˣ⁺ ions underwent specific reactions.
nodes.source_text: Gautam et al. synthesized a tellurium-based heterojunction (VTe₂@ZnFeTe) on Ni foam (NF) through ion exchange reactions employing the hydrothermal method
